svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in 17 states, on a log scale, beside a band of the box's steps from a voice reply's alone (12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms) to the agents' at 24 agent sessions (38 ms), each divided by 1.61, how many times as long the box's CPU takes: the change with its switches off within 29 µs and 4.6% of stock vLLM in every state, and the serving profile's change to the call in each scenario, in the pull requests' cost tables: only lower-priority work (+48 to +182 µs), a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free (+326 to +1,491 µs) and every running slot taken (+158 to +299 µs); in the serving profile: only agents (+20 µs), a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits (−63 µs), a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free (+78 µs) and the step that preempts for a waiting turn (+471 µs), its slowest call 3,158 µs against the band's lower edge at 7,484 µs.
